## Personality

Jane is characterized as a steady and sensible individual. Driven by the financial independence of earning a salary, her goal is to devote her entire life to teaching and to never marry.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P18](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0018)_

## History

Before starting her studies at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), Jane had visited an [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition) twice with Ruby and planned to go again. While attending Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), Jane visited [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at her boarding house alongside [Josie](../character/josie-pye.md) and Ruby. During this visit, they shared the news of an Avery scholarship to [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), which inspired Anne's academic ambitions.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P13](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P1](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P2](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P6](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--jane.md)

Jane and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) are schoolmates and friends who both attend Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) to pursue their studies. Jane visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at her boarding house along with other peers, keeping her connected to news from home. Her presence helps ease Anne's initial homesickness as they navigate their academic ambitions together.

- Friend of — friends and companions  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P2](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P17](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P32](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0032)</sub>

### [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/billy-andrews--jane.md)

Jane and [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md) are brother and sister.

- Sibling of — brother and sister  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P27](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0027)</sub>

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--jane.md)

Jane is part of the broader circle of friends and companions that includes [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Both girls share the experience of seeing their local peers prepare for higher education and milestone examinations as they grow up together in the community.

- Friend of — friends and companions  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P32](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0032)</sub>
